objective: Execute comprehensive Phase 4 production readiness (Phases 4C through 4K): financial audit trail & idempotency, repository persistence layer, deployment Docker/scripts, CI/CD workflows, structured observability, backup/restore, frontend polish & error boundary, legal privacy/terms, and pilot end-to-end smoke verification.
acceptance_criteria: Audit service tracks all financial mutations with actor, entity, action, and request_id
Ledger entries support idempotency keys and non-destructive reversal adjustments
Repository abstraction layer supports both Firestore and dev/test storage
Live dashboard forecast calculation without hardcoded numbers
Production Dockerfile and requirements.txt for backend
Deployment and environment configs in infra/ (Cloud Run, Firebase)
GitHub Actions CI and CD workflows for lint, type check, tests, and build
Structured JSON logging with request correlation IDs
Enhanced health endpoints with readiness and dependency status
Operational runbooks for outages, rollbacks, incidents, and backups
Frontend error boundary and legal pages (Privacy & Terms) with disclaimers
All backend tests (existing 93 + new 4C-4K tests) passing
Frontend build and lint passing with zero errors
non_goals: Do not execute live cloud deployment without real GCP credentials
Do not break backward compatibility with existing tests
